description: fvoci cache rules (D-77). PUT to /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/phases/http_request_cache_settings/entrypoint replaces every cache rule of the zone; merge by hand if the zone has others. Keep fvoci_sensitive_bypass LAST so no later rule can make those paths cacheable.

rules.description: Hashed static files: cache and follow the origin Cache-Control (public, max-age=31536000, immutable). Cloudflare may recompress them.
API, sign-in and health: never cached at the edge, origin Cache-Control (no-store / private, no-cache) passed to browsers unchanged, strong ETags kept for If-Match.
rules.expression: http.request.uri.path eq "/api" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/auth" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/healthz"
